approval.rejectConfirmBody: “{summary}” will be rejected and will not run.
approval.confirmBodyAfter: and is spent once. If the commit, the branch or the remote moves before it is carried out, it is refused and asked for again.
approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.emptyBody: Protected actions — pushes, deploys, or policy gates waiting for your approval — will appear here.
audit.chainBroken: The chain does NOT hold at record {at} ({problem}).
audit.emptyMatchingBody: Nothing recorded for {type} on this page.
audit.emptyBody: Governance actions will appear here as they happen.
decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.emptyBody: Policy evaluations for agent and account actions will appear here.
decisions.heldByNote: “Held by” says what stands behind a decision: boundary (the container, the broker or the proxy: the agent cannot change it), control (Orbit Web's API), runtime (the agent runtime's own configuration: defence in depth, not a boundary).
desk.notText: Not text: {bytes}. What it holds is not shown here.
desk.truncatedFile: Only the first {shown} of {total} is shown.
desk.staleClean: The desk changed since you opened it: nothing was removed. It is read again below.
desk.title: {name}'s desk
desk.description: {measured} · desk version {version}. Read only: what its accepted work left, and the toolbox it wrote for itself. Every look is recorded in the audit.
desk.emptyKeepToolbox: Empty the desk, keep the toolbox…
desk.toolboxFoldersStay: The toolbox's folders stay; what is in them may be chosen.
desk.emptyWarning: Everything in the desk but toolbox/ is removed: the files its accepted work left there.
desk.cacheWarning: The packages it downloaded (pip, npm and the like) are removed; its tools download them again when they need them.
desk.cannotBeUndone: This cannot be undone. Its next work starts from what is left.
desks.deleteReason: Desk deleted from Governance → Employee desks
desks.staleDelete: This employee changed since the page read it: nothing was deleted. Read the list again.
desks.holdsStorage: Holds {held} of the account's storage: desk {desk}{cache} ({measured}).
desks.holdsWorkNow: It holds work now: its desk is cleaned up once that work is done.
desks.deleteConfirmBody: Its desk and toolbox, its cache and every workspace it kept are deleted for good, and {held} of the account's storage is released once they are gone. What it delivered stays with the work it was given. This cannot be undone.
desks.title: Employee desks
desks.description: Every employee's desk: what its accepted work left there, and the toolbox it wrote for itself. Open one to look into it — read only, each look recorded in the audit — and clean it up when it fills. An employee who leaves keeps its desk, read only, and its storage stays committed until you delete it: {committed} of the account's {budget} is committed now.
desks.emptyTitle: No employee has a desk yet.
desks.emptyBody: An employee's desk is made when it is hired; it is listed here from then on.
network.limit.connectionsPerMinutePerRun: New connections per minute, per run
network.limit.concurrentConnectionsPerRu: Open connections at once, per run
network.title: Employee network access
network.description: What an employee's sandbox may reach on the internet. Chats and research keep their own rules.
network.defaultNotice: This revision does not say, so employee runs use Autonomous.{editable}
network.defaultEditable: Changing it here adds it to the draft.
network.modeAutonomous: Autonomous — every public website, ports 80 and 443, with no per-site approval
network.modeRestricted: Restricted — only the hosts listed below
network.noneRestricted: None: in Restricted mode nothing outside is reached.
network.hostInputHint: An exact host (docs.example.com) or a whole domain (*.example.com).
network.footerNote: In both modes private, loopback, link-local and cloud-metadata addresses are refused, and every connection is logged for the work it belongs to. Switching from Restricted back to Autonomous is a high-risk change: it is reviewed as one before it is published.
findings.chainBroken: The audit chain does not hold at record {at}: findings after it stand on records that may have been changed.
findings.title: Security findings
findings.description: Deterministic checks run directly over your account's audit record, without any model reading your records.
findings.emptyTitle: No finding: nothing in the record fits a rule.
findings.emptyBody: If an unusual pattern or denied action appears in the audit record, it will surface here with links to the underlying events.
overview.deployment.single: Single-container deployment: the agent runs in Orbit Web's own container, beside every other account's runs. Your records are your account's alone, but the agent's isolation from Orbit Web is not proven here.
overview.deployment.governed: Governed deployment: the agent runs in a container of its own, reached through a runner, and reaches the network only through Orbit Web's egress proxy.
overview.source.agent: Proposed by an agent and confirmed by you
overview.source.default: The default policy Orbit Web published for your account
overview.source.copy: A copy of an earlier revision
overview.nowDescription: The governance of {name}: your chats, your research and your policy. Nobody else's, and nobody else decides here.
overview.noPolicy: No policy is in effect: nothing a run asks is allowed until you publish one.
overview.overridesCount: {countText} narrow it, each for one chat or research workspace.
overview.chainBroken: The chain does NOT hold at record {at} ({problem}).
overview.chainNote: The chain shows a record of your account changed, removed or reordered after it was written. It is tamper evidence on this host, not proof against somebody who controls the host and every copy of its head.
overview.isolationChecked: Checked {at} — the agent container's own answer: a check of the deployment's wiring, not proof against a runner the agent has taken over.
policy.revName.none: nothing: no policy is in effect, so it is compared with the deployment's default policy
policy.loosensNothing: It loosens nothing against the revision in effect{narrowed}.
policy.reviewIntro: Publishing makes exactly this content your policy in effect at once, for every chat and research workspace of your account and every decision. You confirm it yourself: nobody else is asked.
policy.impactUnread: What it would change could not be worked out: it is confirmed as a high-risk change.
policy.ackRisk: I have read what it changes and accept its {risk} risk
policy.simDescription: Asks this revision what it would decide. Nothing is recorded and nothing is allowed by asking.
policy.agentDraftBanner: An agent handed in this draft. Nothing in it is in effect: read it, and only you can validate, confirm and publish it.
policy.readOnlyBanner: Read only: a {kind} revision never changes. Start a new draft to change your policy.
policy.cannotShow: This revision cannot be shown: {problem}. Start a new draft from the policy in effect.
policy.confirmDiscardBody: Unsaved edits and this draft revision will be discarded.
policy.dirtyHint: Save the draft before you validate or publish it.
policy.revisionsDesc: Your account's policy: a draft is validated, reviewed and confirmed by you before it is in effect.
policy.newDraft: New draft from the policy in effect
policyTable.limit.noEnforcement: Nothing in Orbit Web carries this out: always denied.
policyTable.limit.neverAgent: Never an agent: what is ticked applies to you.
policyTable.limit.agentApproval: An agent always waits for your approval of exactly the action.
policyTable.limit.egress: Any host not in the list below.
policyTable.limit.push: Allowed alone: the agent pushes the chat's own branch itself, at once (another branch waits for you) -- never forced, never to the default or a protected branch.
policyTable.hostsDesc: Through the egress proxy, in the governed deployment. Claude Code's own service is always listed: without it no run can reach the model.
policyTable.hostFormatHint: A host and its port: name:port.
policyTable.obDefaultDecision: Anything no rule speaks about waits for your approval (unticked: it is denied)
policyTable.obAuditAll: Record every decision in the audit record (unticked: only those that did not simply allow)
policyTable.obIsolation: A run starts only where the agent's isolation was proven
policyTable.keptTitle: Rules the table does not show
policyTable.bindingNote: Binding: a mandatory rule binds every department; a default one is your answer for an action you delegate to departments, which a department's own answer replaces.
reports.generateDesc: Produces a frozen, cited summary of one UTC day from the audit record alone.
reports.title: Reports
reports.emptyBody: Select a UTC day above and click Generate to create your first daily report.
resources.workspace.title: Workspaces
resources.workspace.about: Your chats: each one a Claude Code workspace, under your policy.
resources.workspace.emptyBody: Chats you start will appear here with per-workspace policy overrides.
resources.research_workspace.title: Research workspaces
resources.research_workspace.about: Your research workspaces, under your policy.
resources.research_workspace.emptyBody: Research workspaces you create will appear here with per-workspace policy overrides.
resources.overrideEgressNote: Every host, Claude Code's own service included: denied, a run here cannot reach the model.
resources.overrideDesc: It narrows your policy for this {one} alone: an action can wait for your approval or be denied here, never be allowed more. An allow in an override changes nothing -- loosening is done in your policy.
resources.deletedBanner: It was deleted: nothing runs there to narrow, so its override cannot change.
resources.rulesNotShown: Rules these rows do not show
resources.noPolicyInEffect: No policy is in effect: nothing a run asks here is allowed until you publish one.
sim.asEmployee: Asked as that employee's assignment: an agent's request, decided with its department's policy too.
sim.asAnybody: Choose a department or an employee to ask as one of your employees' assignments.
models.inputHint: The runtime, then the model: claude:sonnet.
models.inputInvalid: Not a model: runtime:model, as claude:sonnet.
delegation.title: Delegation to departments
delegation.description: What each department may decide for its own employees' work, and how far. What you do not delegate, a department may only narrow. A department's policy never reaches a chat, a research question or a person.
delegation.mode.none: Not delegated: a department may only narrow yours
delegation.mode.RESTRICTED: Up to Restricted: only the hosts it lists
delegation.mode.AUTONOMOUS: Up to Autonomous: every public website
delegation.actionsDesc: For each, the loosest answer a department may give its employees. Your own rule for it is replaced by the department's only where you mark it Default; a Mandatory one binds every department.
delegation.nothingDelegated: Nothing is delegated: a department may only narrow what your policy says.
delegation.neverEmployees: Never an employee's, whatever a department says: delegating it changes nothing.
delegation.modeLabel: The loosest mode a department may choose
delegation.anyHost: A department may list any public host
delegation.noHosts: None: a department may list no host.
delegation.limitsTitle: The highest limits a department may set
delegation.limitHint: Empty: your own limit, if you set one, is the most it may set.
delegation.anyModel: A department may choose any model your policy allows
delegation.modelsLabel: Models a department may choose among
delegation.noModels: None: a department may choose no model.
departments.title: Departments
departments.about: Each department may have a policy of its own for its employees' work, inside what your policy delegates to it; one without inherits yours. Departments are made in the Office.
departments.emptyBody: Departments you create in the Office appear here, each with its policy.
deptPolicy.locked.ceiling: Never more for an employee: the deployment's ceiling.
deptPolicy.locked.not_delegated: Not delegated: the department may only narrow it.
deptPolicy.locked.mandatory: Mandatory: your rule binds the department.
deptPolicy.rowsDesc: Row by row: what your policy says and whether it binds, how far you let the department go, what the department says, and what is in effect for its employees, worked out by the same evaluate() every decision uses.
deptPolicy.networkDesc: What its employees' sandboxes may reach: your policy's, with what the department sets within what you delegate.
deptPolicy.nothingInEffect: Nothing is in effect: your policy has no revision in effect.
deptPolicy.networkCapped: Held to your delegation: {fields}. What the department chose goes beyond what you let it choose now.
deptPolicy.modelsTitle: Models its employees may run on
deptPolicy.modelsDesc: Your list, narrowed by the department's within what you delegate.
deptPolicy.runtimeDesc: What its employees' attempts are held to in the kernel: the strictest of the deployment's floor, your policy and the department's own.
deptPolicy.modelsCapped: Held to your delegation: a model the department named is not one you let it choose, and is left out.
deptPolicy.headerDesc: A department of your company: its policy decides its employees' work, under yours.
deptPolicy.noCompanyRevision: Your policy has no revision in effect.
deptPolicy.companyRevision: Worked out under your policy's revision {revision}.
deptPolicy.inherits: Inherits the company's policy: the department has no policy of its own in effect.
deptPolicy.ownInEffect: Its own policy in effect: revision {revision}, published {at}.
deptPolicy.noCompanyPolicy: Your policy has no revision in effect: nothing is decided for this department's employees, and its policy is validated only once you publish one.
deptPolicy.scopeNote: Applies to this department's employees' work only — never to Chat, Research or people. Agents can only propose drafts; only you publish.
deptPolicy.cannotShow: This revision cannot be shown: {problem}. Start a new draft from the one in effect.
deptPolicy.revName.none: nothing: the department has no policy of its own in effect, so it is compared with yours alone
deptPolicy.reviewIntro: Publishing makes exactly this content {name}'s policy in effect at once, for its employees' work — never a chat, a research question or a person. You confirm it yourself: nobody else is asked.
deptPolicy.revisionsDesc: A draft is validated against what you delegate, then reviewed and confirmed by you before it is in effect for this department's employees.
deptPolicy.newDraft: New draft from the one in effect
deptPolicy.noRevision: No revision yet: the department inherits your policy.
deptPolicy.simDescription: Asks what your policy in effect and {which} would decide for one of {name}'s employees, for its assignment's work: the same evaluate() every decision is made by. Nothing is recorded and nothing is allowed by asking.
deptEditor.rowsDesc: For each action, the department's own answer for its employees, or none and yours applies. It is never looser than you delegate; an action you do not delegate it may only narrow.
deptEditor.networkDesc: Each part the department leaves unset inherits yours; what it sets is held to what you delegate.
deptEditor.ownHosts: Its own list of hosts (unticked: inherits yours)
deptEditor.modelsTitle: Models its employees may run on
deptEditor.runtimeDesc: The department may only raise your mode or add a control for its employees; it never lowers either.
deptEditor.ownModels: Its own list of models (unticked: inherits yours)
deptEditor.noModels: None: its employees may run on no model.
findings.noFiltered: No security findings match this filter.
runtime.title: Runtime security
runtime.description: What your employees' attempts are held to while their programs run, and what this host has proven it can observe and prevent. The mode is part of your policy (Governance → Policy).
runtime.notEnabled: Kernel runtime protection is not enabled on this host: employees run under the sandbox's own controls only. An operator enables it (ORBIT_WEB_RUNTIME_SECURITY=tetragon).
runtime.observeIsNotPrevention: Observation is not prevention: in observe mode the sensor reports what runs and what a control would have refused, and refuses nothing.
runtime.enforceUnproven: Your policy requires enforced runtime security, and this host has not proven it can prevent (prevent.exec {state}): employees' attempts are refused before they start.
runtime.sessionsObserved: Chats, research and CEO Chat are observed by the deployment's floor -- never held to an employee's policy, never enforced.
runtime.sessionsNotObserved: Chats, research and CEO Chat are not observed: runtime security covers employees' attempts.
runtime.telemetry: Last event {last} · lost {lost} · from no attempt {unattributed} · kept {days} days
runtime.noProbe: The host has not been probed yet: nothing is claimed.
runtime.noWorkloads: No attempt is held by runtime security now.
runtime.resolvedHolds: Resolved, and it still holds this assignment's Retry: authorize a retry, with a reason, to release it.
runtime.notePlaceholder: What you looked at, and why
policyTable.runtimeNote: What employees' attempts are held to while their programs run: disabled (the sandbox alone), observe (reported, nothing refused) or enforce (installed, proven by a probe before anything runs, and kept proven -- or the attempt is refused and a running one contained). Departments may only tighten it; lowering it is a high-risk change.
policyTable.runtimeHost: This host has proven prevention: {state} (a prediction, not evidence).
policyTable.runtimeWouldRefuse: enforce would refuse every attempt here
